description: This file defines the API for accessing BDF-specific strings in the FreeType project, including enums, structures, and function declarations related to BDF font properties.

methods.name: FT_Get_BDF_Charset_ID
methods.description: Retrieves the charset ID of a BDF font, including encoding and registry strings.

methods.name: FT_Get_BDF_Property
methods.description: Retrieves a specific BDF property from a font, returning an error if not found.
